meta.name: memory-setup
meta.description: Enable and configure Moltbot/Clawdbot memory search for persistent context. Use when setting up memory, fixing "goldfish brain," or helping users configure memorySearch in their config. Covers MEMORY.md, daily logs, and vector search setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置记忆搜索以保持对话上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让机器人记住之前的对话内容
copy.tagline_en: Configure memory search to keep conversation context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your bot to remember past conversations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会启用持久记忆搜索，能记住之前的对话、偏好和项目进度，并在回答前自动查找相关记忆。
howto.when: 当用户询问关于过去讨论、决定、日期、人物、偏好或待办事项时触发。

say.text: 你还记得我之前提过的项目计划吗？
say.note: Claude 会搜索记忆并返回相关上下文。

say.text: 我上次做的决定是什么？
say.note: Claude 会从 MEMORY.md 中查找。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude enables persistent memory search, recalling past conversations, preferences, and project progress, and automatically searches relevant memory before answering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about past discussions, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project plan I mentioned before?
say_en.note: Claude will search memory and return relevant context.
Claude will look it up from MEMORY.md.
